proposal_title: 100‑epoch Confirmation of Local Width 14 on ECG200
comment: Approved for scientific review. The w14 candidate is a valid next test of the local-width response curve. Run the preregistered ECG200 protocol with seeds 301–305, 100 epochs, concurrent w16 control, and the fixed gate w14_correct >= w16_correct - 10. Interpret the result as evidence for this specific configuration only.
